name: requests
command: g="${GANYMEDE_BIN:-ganymede}"; "$g" mcp watch --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; e=; [ -n "$GANYMEDE_WATCH_EDITS" ] && "$g" mcp watch --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- --edits && e=--edits; exec "$g" mcp watch --client claude-code $e
description: Requests to you that a person writes in a journal (@agent cells)
